title: 第十九章 九叔你要老婆不要第二十章 谆谆教诲
content_zh:
;;
“这位小姐我好像在哪里见过。”夜半三更，秦尧带着女鬼来到义庄前，提着油灯为他们开门的秋生借着火光抬头一望，顿时有了精神。
“别色眯眯的看着人家。”秦尧勾住他的肩膀，提水壶般将他带入院中：“师叔走了吗？”
“擦黑就走了，现在可能已经到地府了。”秋生说着，还是忍不住地回头观望。
“师弟，你不是送阿威队长去了吗，怎么带了一个女子回来？”听到动静的文才披着衣服走了出来，看了看秦尧，又看了看董小玉，脸上浮现出一丝迷惘。
不同于秋生的老弱通吃，文才还是更偏爱年轻貌美的女子，因此对董小玉并未产生对任婷婷的那种一眼万年。
“此事说来话长……”秦尧开口。
文才与秋生一起点了点头，默默做好了听长篇大论的准备，岂料秦尧话锋一转：“就不给你们说了。”
文才：“……”
秋生：“……”
你哪怕长话短说也行啊。
总好过什么都不说。
“你们先在这里陪董小姐说说话，或者各自回房睡觉也行，我去看看师父醒没醒。”秦尧装作没看到二人带着一丝怨念的眼神，大步走向九叔卧房。
“师父。”
因怕惊扰到九叔，秦尧并未敲门，仅仅是站在门外，轻声唤道。
话音刚落，漆黑的房间内便亮起一盏灯火，穿戴整齐的九叔打开门栓：“进来吧。”
秦尧走进房间，看着他身上一丝不乱的深黄色道袍：“您一直在等我！”
九叔对此不置可否：“回来就好……这么晚还来找我，是有话要说？”
秦尧呵呵一笑：“是有事儿要说，师父，你要老婆不要？”
九叔：“？”

秦尧眼中浮现出一抹慈爱：“师父，你也老大不小了，是时候为自己考虑考虑了。”
九叔：“？？？”
“你要老婆……只要你开金口，我这就给你领进来。”
九叔：“……”
“不说话，就是默认了。”秦尧转身：“那行，您稍等片刻，我这就把她带进来。”
“你站住！”不知是怒是羞，九叔脸色涨的通红：“谁让你这么做的？”
秦尧：“无人指使，纯粹是弟子的一片孝心。”
九叔：“……”
好孝！
“你把她带过来我看看。”
“是，师父。”秦尧一听，以为这事儿有谱，脸上不禁浮现出一抹笑容，大步出门。
“民女董小玉，拜见林道长。”晚些，女鬼跟着秦尧踏入九叔卧房，盈盈下拜。
九叔打第一眼看到董小玉时就开始皱眉，并非因为她是女鬼，而是他看到了秦尧不曾看到的东西……

"I seem to have seen this lady somewhere before." At midnight, Qin Yao and the female ghost came to Yizhuang. Qiu Sheng, who opened the door for them with an oil lamp, looked up in the light of the fire and suddenly became energetic.
"Don't look at me with such mischievous eyes." Qin Yao hooked his shoulder and led him into the courtyard like a kettle: "Uncle Master is gone?"
"He left after wiping it all off. He may have arrived in the underworld now." Qiu Sheng said, but couldn't help but look back.
"Junior brother, didn't you send Captain Awei away? Why did you bring a woman back?" Wencai, who heard the commotion, walked out with his clothes on. He looked at Qin Yao and then at Dong Xiaoyu, with a trace of confusion on his face.
Unlike Qiu Sheng, who favors young and beautiful women, Wen Cai still prefers young and beautiful women, so he does not have the same kind of love for Dong Xiaoyu that he has for Ren Tingting.
"It's a long story..." Qin Yao said.
Wen Cai and Qiu Sheng nodded together, silently preparing to listen to a long speech. Unexpectedly, Qin Yao changed the topic and said, "I won't tell you anymore."
Wencai: "..."
Qiu Sheng: "..."
Even if you keep your story short, that's fine.
It's better than saying nothing.
"You can chat with Miss Dong here first, or you can go back to your room to sleep. I'll go see if master is awake." Qin Yao pretended not to notice the look in their eyes with a hint of resentment, and strode towards Uncle Jiu's bedroom.
"Master."
For fear of disturbing Uncle Jiu, Qin Yao did not knock on the door, but just stood outside the door and called softly.
As soon as he finished speaking, a light lit up in the dark room, and the neatly dressed Uncle Jiu opened the door bolt: "Come in."
Qin Yao walked into the room and looked at his neat dark yellow Taoist robe: "You have been waiting for me!"
Uncle Jiu was noncommittal about this: "Just come back... You came to me so late. Do you have something to say?"
Qin Yao chuckled: "I have something to say. Master, do you want a wife or not?"
Uncle Jiu: "?"
A touch of kindness appeared in Qin Yao's eyes: "Master, you are no longer young. It's time to think about yourself."
Uncle Jiu: "???"
"You want a wife...as long as you open the mouth of Chrysostom, I will bring her in for you right away."
Uncle Jiu: "..."
"If you don't speak, you are acquiescing." Qin Yao turned around and said, "Okay, please wait a moment, I will bring her in right now."
"Stop!" Whether it was anger or shame, Uncle Jiu's face turned red: "Who asked you to do this?"
Qin Yao: "No one instructs me, it's purely a disciple's filial piety."
Uncle Jiu: "..."
So filial!
"Bring her here and let me take a look."
"Yes, Master." Upon hearing this, Qin Yao thought that this was something, a smile appeared on his face, and he strode out.
"Daughter Dong Xiaoyu, pay homage to Taoist Lin." Later, the female ghost followed Qin Yao into Uncle Jiu's bedroom and bowed down.
Uncle Jiu started to frown when he first saw Dong Xiaoyu, not because she was a female ghost, but because he saw something Qin Yao had never seen...
